description.value: Bao is an Asian fusion restaurant situated in Victoria's historic Chinatown, specializing in Taiwanese steam buns (Gua Bao) with a rotating cast of fillings alongside ramen, bibimbap, and Korean fried chicken. The compact, focused menu reflects a blend of East and Southeast Asian flavours, with most dishes available in vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free adaptations on request. It makes a solid mid-ride meal stop given its Chinatown location and dine-in or takeout flexibility.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 92m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is open and operating at 626 Fisgard Street in Victoria's Chinatown. The menu explicitly mentions takeout orders and multiple vegetarian/vegan/GF options. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name is 'Bao' but website consistently refers to the business as 'Bao Restaurant' — minor discrepancy, OSM value retained per rules.
No phone number in OSM tags; phone (250) 590-8688 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant in Victoria's Chinatown with a confirmed website, address, and active menu. A useful food stop for touring cyclists.

Takeout.detail: Website states '15% Gratuity added to all takeout orders over $100', confirming takeout service is offered

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists dedicated vegetarian/vegan items (Shanghai Black Bean Croquette, Mala 5 Mushroom bao, Korean Fried Tofu Bibimbap) and notes 'GF upon request' and 'Vegetarian/Vegan options available upon request' on multiple dishes
